text:
elaine: Quick: planning a config-only rollout for chat-v2 routing limits and batching during the midnight window. Canary 7% for 20m. No model binary changes.

matt: Which knobs exactly? Affected environments?

elaine: Adjusting tenant_soft_limit 210->160, reduce max_concurrent_streams 12->9, bump batch_window_ms 8->14 and max_batch_size 20->26. Hosted + Dedicated only; Private unchanged.

sophie: Please pin dedicated to chat-v2@2026-06-01 and add auto-fail to route to chat-v2-legacy if error_rate > 1% for 3m. Also run staging preflight.

elaine: Pushed YAML to bundle and queued deploy. Snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  route: chat-v2
  model_pin: "chat-v2@2026-06-01"
limits:
  tenant_soft_limit_tokens: 160
  max_concurrent_streams: 9
batching:
  max_batch_size: 26
  batch_window_ms: 14
failover:
  on_error_pct: 1.0
  route_to: chat-v2-legacy
```

deploy-bot: Queued `/deploy-config --service=routing --change=midnight-batch-safety --canary=0.07 --duration=20m --pin=model:chat-v2@2026-06-01`

staging-bot: [preflight] 250 reqs, errors=0, p50=130ms, p95=360ms, mem +4%

oncall: Noting a minor autoscaler tweak in ap-northeast at +6m. Recommend excluding that region for the canary.

elaine: Excluding ap-northeast, starting canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6378901250  traffic 7% (no ap-northeast). Auto-fail on error_rate > 1% for sliding 3m or p95 > 2000ms for 5m.

matt: t+10m metrics look fine: errors 0.09%, p50 +30ms, p95 steady, token cost -7%. Proceed to ramp to 40% in 10m if green.

elainE: (typo) meant elaine: Proceeding to ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 40% at 6378901270.

oncall: ap-northeast autoscaler clear; include on next expansion.

elaine: Will monitor for 30m then schedule full roll if no regressions. Adding note to release page.

deploy-bot: Thread closed at 6378901280  config active at 40% (full roll scheduled pending green metrics).
